title: Forge version output
description: The JSON object emitted by `forge version --format json`. Frozen by WBS 17.4.1. Any breaking change to field names requires an ADR. See docs/reference/version-output.md for the field semantics and docs/decisions/ADR-046-version-metadata-and-provenance.md for the rationale.

version.description: Semantic version of the build, or "dev" for a local build, or an empty string for an uninstrumented build. The value may contain a -dirty suffix or a commit offset (e.g. v1.4.2-3-gabc1234). Not validated as SemVer by the schema; the build system is responsible for the format.

commit.description: Short Git SHA of the built commit, or "none" outside a git working tree, or an empty string for an uninstrumented build.

buildDate.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the build, or the empty string for an uninstrumented build. The schema enforces the RFC 3339 shape and the trailing Z, because the reproducible-builds contract (docs/guides/reproducible-builds.md) requires UTC.

dirty.description: True if the build was produced from a working tree with uncommitted changes; false otherwise. A released binary always reports false: the release pipeline refuses to run on a dirty tree.

buildType.description: The environment the binary was built in. `release` is set by the release pipeline; `ci` by a non-release CI job; `local` by a contributor's machine or by any build that carries no explicit value.
